tasks.title: Composer pill markup and styles
tasks.notes: Embedded-assets build succeeded; composer contract test passes with three icon-only segments, 2px dividers, expansion and reduced-motion CSS assertions. Visual check follows in PILL-02. Replaced the box glyph with three stacked queue lines ending in a forward arrow; embedded composer contract asserts the new SVG path and icon-only Stop | Steer | Queue order. go test ./... and go vet ./... pass; running port 9090 serves the new markup. Headless Chrome sampled 44→127→132→52px through expansion/collapse and computed borderTopLeftRadius remained 22px throughout. CSS contract test passes; rebuilt port 9090 serves the update.
